name: jaynes
description: Conducts Claude Code through a method one step at a time, checks each step, and asks you only where it matters

args: for j in "$(command -v jaynes)" "$HOME/.local/bin/jaynes"; do if [ -n "$j" ] && [ -x "$j" ]; then exec "$j" mcp; fi; done; echo 'jaynes is not installed: the Jaynes skill installs it' >&2; exit 1
